environment.description: Go microservice deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 bare-metal host, running as user 'appuser'. No MAC framework enabled (AppArmor in complain mode only, effectively permissive). Service is directly exposed on port 8080 via L4 load balancer with no rate limiting. API keys file at /etc/myapp/secrets/api_keys.txt is readable by appuser. Network latency is minimal (<0.1ms jitter) allowing precise timing measurements.

config.network: L4 TCP passthrough, no rate limiting
